lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 high-contrast white vertical lines are visible; spacing is wider on the anterior torso and becomes progressively more dense toward the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped topological split is visible on the eleventh line from the anterior, bifurcating at the upper dorsal region of the torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first, second, and third lines from the anterior terminate at the ventral midpoint; the fourth line exhibits a dashed termination before the lower torso boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 4 distinct high-contrast white spots is located on the mid-to-lower posterior haunch; two additional spots are visible lower on the hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the posterior haunch align spatially to form a semi-diagonal geometric line at approximately a 45-degree angle relative to the spine.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns follow a straight trajectory for the proximal 80% with a slight outward lyrate curvature at the distal tips, oriented at a ~60-degree angle from the skull base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Estimated 3:1 ratio between the pixel distance of the terminal horn tips and the pixel width of the combined horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.10 ratio of high-contrast ivory-colored tipping relative to the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: White transverse chevron on the nasal bridge; two white spots on the lower cheek/jaw; white bands on the upper segments of all four limbs; white fringe visible on the ventral neck.
